0022600127.text: The Golden State Warriors (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) visit the Denver Nuggets (1-1, on a one-game winning streak) in the Warriors' fourth game of the season, with Golden State 5th in the Pacific and 15th in the West and Denver 4th in the Northwest and 8th in the West. Golden State is missing Al Horford, Brandin Podziemski, Draymond Green, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody, Stephen Curry and Gui Santos, who is day-to-day, while Denver is without Alpha Diallo, Cameron Johnson, Julian Strawther and Spencer Jones. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on March 29, 2026 in Denver, where the Warriors lost 116-93.
